_what: Per-OSM-way walking-surface width in metres, measured off the City of Austin's planimetric impervious-surface survey. OPT-IN: a way with no row here keeps bake_ground.py's DEFAULT_WIDTH. A missing row NEVER means 'no walk here' -- the city's survey does not cover all of UT's interior.

source.licence: City of Austin open GIS (impervious_cover_2023). Public domain: the City publishes its open data free and without restriction.
